title: Pricing and What Is Included | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton, Maine
description: Request wedding pricing for R&SVP – Hio Ridge in Bridgton, Maine. Tables and chairs are included. Explore the spaces and ask Susan about rental details.
heading: Wedding pricing and rental details
lede: Dinner beneath the beams starts with a place for everyone at the table. We include tables and chairs with rental. Ask Susan for our pricing brochure and a rate for your plans. [CONFIRM: which spaces and services are included in the wedding rental]
price_note: We host Sunday weddings and weekday events, May through October. Ask Susan for the rate for your plans. [CONFIRM: weekday and event rates]
included: Dining space on the barn's main floor and in the loft. Up to 135 guests per event
A bridal room and a separate groom's room in the ell
A ceremony field facing Pleasant Mountain, with benches made from old floorboards
A patio with string lights and a stone seating circle
Tables and chairs included with rental. Long and round tables available
A prep kitchen for your outside caterer
Parking for 66 cars, plus three accessible spaces
An ADA bathroom and a ramp to the barn's main floor
Susan and Richard on site at events
[CONFIRM: setup and breakdown, hours of access, rehearsal time]
compare_heading: Raise a glass *without a bar bill.*
compare: We host celebrations without alcohol. Everyone can join the toast, and you won't need to budget for alcohol. As you compare venues, check the rental hours and what's included alongside the price. [CONFIRM: Susan is comfortable with this comparison]
events: Gather around the barn tables for a shower or family meal. Tell Susan the kind of event and your approximate guest count so you can discuss availability and a quote. [CONFIRM: event rates]

closing.heading: Get the pricing brochure
closing.body: You don't need a date to ask about costs. Contact Susan for the brochure and tell us what you're considering.
